description: Source code for automated tests of GatewayConnectionController in the OpenClaw iOS application. Contains test functions verifying default display name handling, capability toggles, command generation, operator connection options, operator approval scope logic, and last connection persistence.

methods.name: resolvedDisplayNameSetsDefaultWhenMissing
methods.description: Tests setting a default display name when the stored value is missing or nil.

methods.name: currentCapsReflectToggles
methods.description: Verifies that capability toggles (camera, screen, location, voice wake) reflect user defaults.

methods.name: currentCommandsIncludeLocationWhenEnabled
methods.description: Checks that location-related commands are included when enabled in user defaults.

methods.name: currentCommandsExcludeDangerousSystemExecCommands
methods.description: Ensures that certain system commands are excluded for safety reasons.

methods.name: operatorConnectOptionsOnlyRequestApprovalScopeWhenEnabled
methods.description: Verifies that operator connect options request approval scope only when enabled.

methods.name: operatorApprovalScopeRequestsStayBackwardCompatible
methods.description: Checks backward compatibility for operator approval scope requests based on stored scopes.

methods.name: loadLastConnectionReadsSavedValues
methods.description: Tests reading the last connection details from keychain storage after saving manually.

methods.name: loadLastConnectionReturnsNilForInvalidData
methods.description: Verifies that invalid data in stored last connection results in nil being returned.
